name: com.genex.ai
description: Play-time AI for a Genex game: the game asks a model for text, or for JSON that fits a C# type, and Genex answers on the model the person chose. Results enter the game only through GenexAi.Drain(), once per FixedUpdate. Genex relays it while the game plays in this editor; a build shipped outside Genex answers ai_off and plays its fallbacks.
